correctness.rationale: Gaussian regression yields exact posterior means for each feasible first and second observation; conditioning on the initial standardized reading converts the contingent decision to max(rho^2 Z^2,rho a^2). Exhaustion of all three first sensors proves globally optimal adaptive selection, including randomized policies. Direct Gaussian integration and differentiation prove strict separation, the unique amplitude threshold and the sharp constant uniformly for all positive noise and goal coefficient. Independent symbolic algebra and high-precision integral/parameter checks passed; finite experiments are used only as checks of an analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The source literature on goal-oriented linear selection (Wu–Chen–Ghattas 2021) and nonadaptive quadratic posterior-variance criteria (Neuberger–Alexanderian–van Bloemen Waanders 2024) does not state an optimum over contingent two-stage Gaussian coordinate policies, the threshold based on the first reading, or its noise-independent sharp \(1+2\phi(1)\) ratio. The Gaussian conditioning and static-pair computations are acknowledged as consequences of known methods, not claimed new. Searches of a published mathematical-record index, related mathematical research, and targeted scholarly literature revealed no equivalent exact adaptive three-sensor theorem. An unindexed identical special-case calculation remains possible; independent priority validation has not been performed.
residual_risks: Unindexed or unpublished independent derivations of this small exact Gaussian policy example may exist.
The 2024 general experimental-design survey and adaptive sampling article were not inspected in full; no whole-document exclusion is claimed.

value.rationale: This resolves the complete minimal three-coordinate, two-reading sequential experiment problem for a natural prediction combining a product interaction and a linear background contribution. It isolates a precise, noise-independent 48.394 percent upper improvement in variance REDUCTION (not posterior risk) unavailable to any fixed pair; moreover the optimally informative initial reading has zero immediate gain, giving a substantive structural counterexample to myopic greedy design. Full parametric optimal policies, limiting boundaries, and sharpness are explicitly justified; the family is not an arbitrary coefficient slice, because the amplitude balances independent competing measurement purposes.
